svg.title: The banner that promised it could never repeat
svg.desc: Two identical preview-banner tiles joined by an equals sign, both funnelling down into one shared seed node, with a collision spark above — a hash collision giving two posts the same banner. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The banner that promised it could never repeat”. A organic lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 1085261960.
